en.headline: Private car flips on Princess Road near PolyU; driver slightly hurt
en.dek: The Transport Department closed all Kowloon Tong-bound lanes near Hong Kong Polytechnic University after the Monday morning crash.
body: A private car overturned on Princess Road near the Hong Kong Polytechnic University at about 8:20am on Monday after striking a roadside railing. Reports said the burgundy vehicle came to rest on its roof and a section of the central barrier was knocked out of place.
The male driver climbed out of the vehicle before rescuers arrived and was taken to hospital with minor injuries. Passing motorists had called for help after seeing the upturned car on the flyover.

The Transport Department said all lanes of Princess Road towards Kowloon Tong near the university were closed because of the accident and advised drivers to use other roads. Traffic in the area was described as heavy while the scene was being cleared.

zh.headline: 公主道近理大私家車撞欄翻轉 往九龍塘全線封閉
zh.dek: 周一早上約8時20分，一輛私家車在紅磡公主道近香港理工大學失控撞欄翻轉，男司機輕傷自行爬出，運輸署封閉往九龍塘方向全線。
body: 周一早上約8時20分，一輛私家車沿公主道往九龍塘方向行駛，至紅磡近香港理工大學對開橋面時撞向路旁鐵欄，全車翻轉四輪朝天，路中一段鐵欄亦被撞歪脫落。
男司機在救援人員到場前已自行爬出車外，受輕傷由救護車送院。途經司機見到車輛翻側後報案。
運輸署宣布，因交通意外，公主道往九龍塘方向近香港理工大學全線封閉，呼籲驗駛人士改用其他道路，當時上址交通繁忙。
